pairs: quod in novissimis diebus instabunt tempora periculosa:
that in the last days perilous times will press near.
Men will be lovers of themselves,
et voluptatum amatores magis quam Dei:
even having the appearance of piety while rejecting its virtue.
ex his enim sunt qui penetrant domos,
For among these are ones who penetrate houses and lead away,
et captivas ducunt mulierculas oneratas peccatis,
like captives, foolish women burdened with sins,
who are led away by means of various desires,
et numquam ad scientiam veritatis pervenientes.
yet never achieving knowledge of the truth.
Quemadmodum autem Jannes et Mambres restiterunt Moysi:
And in the same manner that Jannes and Jambres resisted Moses,
so also will these resist the truth,
But they will not advance beyond a certain point.
insipientia enim eorum manifesta erit omnibus,
For the folly of the latter shall be made manifest to all,
just as that of the former.
Tu autem assecutus es meam doctrinam,
But you have fully comprehended my doctrine,
such things as happened to me at Antioch,
et ex omnibus eripuit me Dominus.
and how the Lord rescued me from everything.
Et omnes, qui pie volunt vivere in Christo Jesu, persecutionem patientur.
And all those who willingly live the piety in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
Mali autem homines et seductores proficient in pejus,
But evil men and deceivers will advance in evil,
Tu vero permane in iis quæ didicisti,
you should remain in those things which you have learned and which have been entrusted to you.
For you know from whom you have learned them.
et quia ab infantia sacras litteras nosti,
And, from your infancy, you have known the Sacred Scriptures,
quæ te possunt instruere ad salutem,
which are able to instruct you toward salvation,
per fidem quæ est in Christo Jesu.
through the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
Omnis Scriptura divinitus inspirata utilis est ad docendum,
All Scripture, having been divinely inspired, is useful for teaching,
so that the man of God may be perfect,
having been trained for every good work.
